Author - Moduland

Cast your vote by reacting to this message. You can also discuss below. Information here may be used to construct an IFV.

:tep_for:  = FOR / AYE
:tep_against:  = AGAINST / NAY
:tep_abstain:  = TEP ABSTAINS
:tep_present:  = NO OPINION / PRESENT
Changed the channel name: [NEXT] GA - Convention On Artistic Usage
Changed the channel name: [AT VOTE - AGAINST] GA - Convention On Artistic Usage
This just seems like a small but useful improvement?

A nation declares certain national branding materials its IP. Someone uses them for "artistic expression" that incites a crowd to violence. This isn't "impersonation, fraud, deception, or other forms of misrepresentation" and therefore must be protected under that nation's own laws per this proposal

A niche benefit in having a formal requirement for flags and nation names to be in the public domain doesn't outweigh that. I wouldn't support this even if I was a rabid natsov who loved blockers everywhere because nations' ability to use the blocker is tied to the problem I mentioned above
The proposal doesn't need section 3. Without it, you could at least make the small improvement + blocker case
I'm not sure why a proposal about releasing national flags swerves into use of symbols or why that's handcuffed to the blocker
It forces nations into an almost sadistic choice: do we exercise our power to define our own IP even if it makes us less safe?

> A nation declares certain national branding materials its IP. Someone uses them for "artistic expression" that incites a crowd to violence. 

I think that it wouldn't really matter because they're committing a bunch of other crimes in the process and it wouldn't make one iota of a difference whether they used your nation branding materials in the revolution, but this resolution is losing anyways
The problem is the proposal requires protecting use. Incitement to violence is a use
There are other problematic uses. I just used (ha) incitement to violence because that’s the most notable exception to free speech protections (even protected political speech) in the US
…unless you’re Donald Trump inciting a crowd to go storm the capitol, of course
Changed the channel name: [DEFEATED] GA - Convention On Artistic Usage
"Convention on Artistic Usage" was defeated 7,900 votes to 3,230 (29.0% support).
